forum-events.from: forum_events_v1 t LEFT JOIN forum_permissions_v1 p ON p.event_id=t.id

forum-daily-usage.owner: (SELECT $1::text WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM community_account_links l WHERE l.subject_id=$1 AND l.account_id=t.account_id))

hub-events-v2.from: hub_events_v2 t LEFT JOIN hub_intake_v2 i ON i.id=t.object_id

qualification-request-events.from: qualification_permission_request_events t JOIN qualification_permission_requests r ON r.id=t.request_id

task-comment-events-v2.from: task_comment_events_v2 t JOIN task_comments_v2 c ON c.id=t.comment_id

target-governance-events-v2.from: target_governance_events_v2 t JOIN target_reports_v2 r ON r.id=t.report_id

comment-governance-events-v2.from: comment_governance_events_v2 t JOIN comment_reports_v2 r ON r.id=t.report_id

ci-observations-v2.from: ci_observations_v2 t JOIN ci_requests_v2 r ON r.id=t.request_id

recruitment-opportunities.from: recruitment_opportunities t JOIN projects_v2 p ON p.id=t.project_id CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT p.owner_id subject_id UNION SELECT t.publisher_id) own

project-field-sources-v2.from: project_field_sources_v2 t JOIN projects_v2 p ON p.id=t.project_id

project-transfers-v2.from: project_transfers_v2 t CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT t.from_subject_id subject_id UNION SELECT t.to_subject_id) own

contacts-v2.from: contacts_v2 t CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT t.initiator_id subject_id UNION SELECT t.recipient_id) own

experience-events.from: experience_events t JOIN experience_objects o ON o.id=t.object_id

identity-control-heads.from: subject_control_heads t JOIN subject_control_events e ON e.subject_id=t.subject_id AND e.sequence=t.sequence

device-authorizations.from: device_authorizations t JOIN subject_control_events e ON e.id=t.source_event_id

recovery-authorizations.from: recovery_authorizations t JOIN subject_control_events e ON e.id=t.source_event_id

community-accounts.from: community_accounts t JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT account_id,subject_id FROM community_account_links) own ON own.account_id=t.id

community-daily-usage.from: community_daily_usage t JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT account_id,subject_id FROM community_account_links) own ON own.account_id=t.account_id

community-interactions.from: community_interactions t JOIN task_events e ON e.id=t.source_id JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT account_id,subject_id FROM community_account_links) own ON own.account_id=t.account_id AND own.subject_id=e.subject_id

verification-events.from: verification_events t JOIN verification_objects o ON o.id=t.object_id

verification-dependencies.from: verification_dependencies t JOIN verification_objects o ON o.id=t.object_id JOIN verification_events e ON e.object_id=t.object_id AND e.version=t.object_version

builder-probes.from: builder_probes t JOIN builder_events r ON r.id=t.request_id

deletion-events.from: deletion_events t JOIN deletion_requests r ON r.id=t.request_id

observations.from: verification_attempts t JOIN evidence_submissions e ON e.id=t.evidence_id
